title: Al-Latif: The Divine Name for What Is Too Fine to See
excerpt: Al-Latif appears seven times in the Quran. Five pair it with al-Khabir; the two that stand apart are the two where the verse stops describing how God perceives and starts describing how He treats people.
seo_title: Al-Latif: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Latif appears seven times in the Quran, five of them paired with al-Khabir. What the root means and why it carries both subtlety and gentleness.
